nodes.label: Pre-submission anomaly review with severity triage
nodes.norm_label: pre submission anomaly review with severity triage
nodes.summary: Reviewing a graded draft by ordering findings into tiers: submission blockers, factually wrong statements, internal contradictions, bibliography defects, and style. Each tier is a separate section so the student fixes the load-bearing problems first.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - college-assignment-anomaly-review-before-submit [ses_f206b53c8ffeeMpGgDQ94Z9lBg].md:L214] Verify the rule before calling it wrong

nodes.label: Report what is already correct so it is not "fixed"
nodes.norm_label: report what is already correct so it is not fixed
nodes.summary: The review includes an explicit "yang sudah benar, jangan diubah" section listing verified-correct content (the 2,5% / 7,5% PPh 22 rates, the Rp25.000.000 arithmetic, Indonesian number formatting, alphabetical order). The reason for including positive findings is that a defect list alone invites the reader to "correct" things that were never broken.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - college-assignment-anomaly-review-before-submit [ses_f206b53c8ffeeMpGgDQ94Z9lBg].md:L805] Positive findings stop the reader breaking content that is already correct

nodes.label: Freight forwarder is not the same as PPJK
nodes.norm_label: freight forwarder is not the same as ppjk
nodes.summary: Substantive domain correction: freight forwarder (freight, consolidation, warehousing, appointed as the party representing the importer on BC 2.0) is a different entity from PPJK / Pengusaha Pengurusan Jasa Kepabeanan, which exists specifically to handle customs formalities and needs NPWP and API. Conflating the two in one sentence is flagged as an error, not a style choice.

nodes.label: Inward Manifest BC 1.1 is due 24 hours before arrival
nodes.norm_label: inward manifest bc 11 is due 24 hours before arrival
nodes.summary: Verified correction of a quoted rule: BC 1.1 (Inward Manifest) must be submitted at the latest 24 hours BEFORE the vessel arrives, not 24 hours after it berths, with the refinement that when the voyage is shorter than 24 hours the deadline falls before arrival. Cited to PMK 158/PMK.04/2017 jo. PMK 97/PMK.04/2020.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - college-assignment-anomaly-review-before-submit [ses_f206b53c8ffeeMpGgDQ94Z9lBg].md:L214] Verify the rule before calling it wrong

nodes.label: A NIB can serve as an API but is not issued as one automatically
nodes.norm_label: a nib can serve as an api but is not issued as one automatically
nodes.summary: The draft claimed the OSS-issued NIB acts simultaneously as API-P automatically. Corrected: NIB may function as an API, but the importer must select the matching API type (API-P for own-production capital goods and raw materials, API-U for traded goods) and align the KBLI and customs-activity data when filling the OSS form. API is also not mandatory for every importer, which the draft contradicted against its own paragraph 4.

nodes.label: PPh Pasal 22 on imports is a prepayment credit, not a final tax
nodes.norm_label: pph pasal 22 on imports is a prepayment credit not a final tax
nodes.summary: Wording fix with a substantive reason behind it: PPh Pasal 22 is a prepayment that is credited against the annual return, so "wajib membayar" (must pay) overstates it. Restated as "menyetor" (deposits) with the credit note attached. The 2,5% for API holders and 7,5% for non-API were confirmed correct and left untouched.

nodes.label: Citation metadata verified against the source itself
nodes.norm_label: citation metadata verified against the source itself
nodes.summary: Rather than trusting the draft's citation, the year, title and author were read off the source: the YouTube page's own uploadDate metadata gave 2024-12-03 (the draft said 2020), and the Universitas Terbuka catalogue gave the module's real title, author Surono, and 2023 edition. All nine reference URLs were then curl-checked for HTTP 200.

nodes.label: Cited regulations must be checked for revocation and replacement
nodes.norm_label: cited regulations must be checked for revocation and replacement
nodes.summary: Regulations cited in the earlier round turned out to be revoked: PP 5/2021 was revoked by PP 28/2025, and Permendag 36/2023 jo. 03/07/08/2024 was revoked by Permendag 16/2025 jo. Permendag 37/2025 jo. Permendag 18/2026. Both were swapped for the currently in-force chain. PMK 51/2025 and PMK 158/2017 jo. 97/2020 were re-checked and found still in force.

nodes.label: Unverified sources left as explicit placeholders rather than invented
nodes.norm_label: unverified sources left as explicit placeholders rather than invented
nodes.summary: Two reference entries had no known URL. Instead of composing a plausible link, bracket markers were inserted in the file ("URL belum dilengkapi", "identitas penulis modul perlu dikonfirmasi") and listed as remaining work for the user, so nothing false entered the bibliography and the gaps were visible at submission time.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - college-assignment-anomaly-review-before-submit [ses_f206b53c8ffeeMpGgDQ94Z9lBg].md:L950] No invented URLs; leave a marker instead

nodes.label: Backup before an in-place patch, plus an explicit revert command
nodes.norm_label: backup before an in place patch plus an explicit revert command
nodes.summary: The user said "patch now" without answering whether to copy or edit in place, so a timestamped backup was taken first and each round was given its own restore path: `.bak.20260927-patch` undoes everything, `.bak.20260927-links` undoes only the last round. The revert command was given in chat rather than written into the assignment, because a note about reverting would itself be submitted.

nodes.label: Self-introduced corruption caught by a non-ASCII and re-read scan
nodes.norm_label: self introduced corruption caught by a non ascii and re read scan
nodes.summary: Three garbled tokens ("mystic", a CJK fragment, "illustrates") slipped into the rewritten Indonesian paragraphs during editing. They were found by scanning for non-ASCII characters and re-reading the three affected lines, then reported to the user rather than silently corrected.
